name: Team Squirtle: Aerial Deluge & Slumbering Safeguard
archetype: Aerial water artillery, Ghost immunity tanking, and Poison anti-fairy execution.
gym_duel_rationale: Morty's 5v5 Ghost hybrid battle prompts the player to select 5 designated active Pokémon: Blastoise/Fearow levels to Cap 67 to anchor the frontline, using STAB Drill Peck to exploit Hitmonchan/Dusknoir's Flying weakness and launching massive STAB Hydro Pump artillery; Alakazam/Weezing cleanly dismantles Clefable/Spiritomb with super-effective STAB Sludge Bomb and strikes Hitmonchan/Dusknoir with STAB Psychic; Jolteon/Sandslash brings rapid speed control with Discharge and Pin Missile bug pressure; Snorlax brings absolute 100% immunity to all Ghost-type attacks (negating Shadow Balls and Shadow Punches completely), recovering infinitely with Rest and Leftovers while crushing Snorlax/Aegislash with super-effective Crunch; and Arbok/Primeape applies Intimidate to blunt Hitmonchan/Dusknoir's Attack while firing STAB Gunk Shot into Clefable/Spiritomb.

roster.progression_notes: 486 BST starter hybrid elevated to Cap 67. STAB Drill Peck directly exploits Hitmonchan/Dusknoir's Flying weakness. Hydro Pump douses Ghost hybrids.
495 BST Levitate pivot with 118 SpA. STAB Sludge Bomb effortlessly melts Clefable/Spiritomb. STAB Psychic strikes Hitmonchan/Dusknoir.
486 BST speed sweeper. Discharge provides high-speed electrical coverage, while Pin Missile applies multi-hit Bug pressure.
Colossal 160 HP tank. Completely immune to all Ghost moves. Absorbs all Shadow Balls without taking damage; Crunch destroys Snorlax/Aegislash.
479 BST Intimidate bruiser. Cuts Hitmonchan/Dusknoir's Attack on entry. STAB Gunk Shot eliminates Clefable/Spiritomb.
535 BST Water/Ice wall. Sponges special attacks with massive HP, freezing opposing hybrids with Ice Beam during route and cave travel.

flex_bench.rationale: High-durability Grass/Poison tank packing Leech Seed and Sleep Powder for status control.
Intimidate physical pivot and Dragon Dance sweeper with Aqua Tail.
Technician-boosted Triple Kick and Rapid Spin hazard removal for tactical versatility.
